product_one_liner.value: Safety Cloud sends real-time digital alerts about approaching emergency vehicles, work zones, and roadway hazards to motorists through connected vehicles and navigation apps, for emergency-response and roadway fleets seeking safer operations.

pricing_page.notes: The company publishes a pricing page with service options and device pricing.

named_customers.notes: Each organization is named in a HAAS Alert customer case study.

employee_band.notes: Built In reports 70 total employees, which falls in the 51-100 band.

hq_location.notes: HAAS Alert identifies Chicago as its HQ; a directory lists its global headquarters in Chicago, Illinois, United States.

founded_year.notes: The investor page states HAAS Alert was founded in 2015; the company about page also dates the creation of Safety Cloud to 2015.

eng_blog.notes: The media/blog index shows product updates and general roadway-safety/marketing posts, not two engineering-authored posts about product implementation.

public_docs.notes: The public Knowledge Base provides several subject areas and multiple FAQ/integration articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open roles listed are RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer, Product Manager, and Technical Delivery & Solutions Lead; none is an AI/ML or data-science role under the specified title test.

model_provider.notes: The public Knowledge Base, Trust Center/security FAQs, and privacy materials reviewed did not identify an AI model or model provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The Trust Center names SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and GDPR compliance.

last_funding.notes: HAAS Alert announced receipt of a $50,000 Scale Grant on April 17, 2026.

raised_18mo.notes: The April 17, 2026 Scale Grant falls within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open roles listed do not include SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive titles.

launched_6mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 summer release introduced the Safety Cloud mobile app, Mutual Aid expansion, dashboard enhancements, and a new report type, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Brock Aun’s profile lists him as Chief Strategy Officer at HAAS Alert starting July 1, 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The live RevOps Manager / GTM Engineer listing names these systems in HAAS Alert’s existing stack.
